propositions: Five prose blocks upgrade rebar-implement skill and test-design documentation to address parity siblings, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention semantics, oracle gate findings, and known gaps.
Surface-parity census (4a) must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) as in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason.
Config-effect contrast tests (test-design §6) must prove each config key CHANGES BEHAVIOR through real read path, not merely parsing.

Contention triggers (4b) must route three case-c shapes to existing shared suites: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry-reclamation to storm suite, read-integrity-under-contention to sync_contention_harness.
Behavioral gate findings (4g) require RED test-first approach before fix; non-behavioral findings fixed directly.
Phase-5 residual-gap sweep must disposition all out-of-scope census slots, exclusions, and deferred advisories as filed/accepted-with-reason/fixed or none.
